svg.title: How common impairments change a 16-QAM constellation
svg.desc: Eight small simulated 16-QAM constellation diagrams, each with one impairment: noise gives round clouds, phase noise gives arcs, a frequency offset gives rings, IQ gain imbalance stretches the grid, quadrature skew leans it into a rhombus, compression pulls the outer points in, a DC offset shifts the pattern off centre and an interfering tone draws small circles around each point. Grey rings mark the ideal positions.
